text.p: Flores & Rucks Inc said Friday it has completed the purchase from Mobil Oil Exploration & Producing Southeast Inc of interests in 11 producing fields located primarily in the central Gulf of Mexico in federal waters offshore Louisiana for a gross purchase price of $118.8 million.

The number of fields acquired was reduced from the announced 13 fields due to exercise by holders of preferential purchase rights, Flores & Rucks said. In addition, preferential purchase rights remain outstanding through October 16 on interests in two fields.
If exercised, these could further reduce the gross purchase price by $4 million.

The acquisition of the Mobil Corp properties includes working interests in about 125 producing wells now producting 7,500 barrels of oil equivalent per day net to the company. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
